nodes.name: Historiography
nodes.description: The study of the methods, theories, and history of historical writing itself.

nodes.name: Prehistory
nodes.description: The study of human societies before the advent of written records.

nodes.name: Ancient History
nodes.description: The study of the earliest literate civilizations up to the early medieval period.

nodes.name: Medieval History
nodes.description: The study of the Middle Ages, roughly from the fifth to the fifteenth century.

nodes.name: Early Modern History
nodes.description: The study of the period from the Renaissance and Reformation to the eighteenth century.

nodes.name: Modern History
nodes.description: The study of the period from the late eighteenth century through the world wars.

nodes.name: Contemporary History
nodes.description: The study of the recent past from the end of the Cold War to the present.

nodes.name: World History
nodes.description: The comparative and connective study of human history across regions and civilizations.

nodes.name: Social History
nodes.description: The study of the everyday lives, structures, and experiences of ordinary people in the past.

nodes.name: Cultural History
nodes.description: The study of past cultures through beliefs, practices, representations, and material life.

nodes.name: Economic History
nodes.description: The study of economies, markets, and material life in the past.

nodes.name: Political History
nodes.description: The study of states, power, political events, and institutions in the past.

nodes.name: Military History
nodes.description: The study of warfare, armed forces, and their impact on societies.

nodes.name: Diplomatic History

nodes.name: Intellectual History
nodes.description: The study of ideas, thinkers, and the intellectual contexts in which they emerged.

nodes.name: Environmental History
nodes.description: The study of the mutual influence between human societies and the natural environment over time.
